name: Shreyas Sharma
bio: Shreyas is one of the co-founders of Envision and has always been dedicated to bridging the digital divide. Within the team, Shreyas has focused on external and inter-organizational communications and relationship building with partners. With Shreyas's expertise in strategy and applied technology, Envision was able to establish strong and meaningful partnerships to continue to make a positive difference.

name: Rulin Huang
bio: Rulin is a co-founder of Envision. Since its establishment, she has conducted external communication, team building, and action plan making. Rulin has focused on broadcasting the principles of Envision through media and advertising. Through her efforts, the team has successfully hosted community campaigns and expanded the initiative’s influence.

name: Steve Yin
bio: Steve is a student at Concordia International School Shanghai. He is passionate about science, especially biochemistry and immunology, which supports him in his journey of providing civil service. Steve also participates in many other social enterprises. He hopes to help as many people as possible, and Envision is one of the best ways for him to achieve this goal.

name: Amy Wang
bio: Amy is an enthusiastic member of the Envision team. She's always made service one of her life priorities, and she has experience teaching and serving underdeveloped communities in Yunnan and Guizhou. Amy deeply believes that all children deserve high quality educations that allow them to participate fully as members of an increasingly technology-based society.

name: Penny Kim
bio: Penny, part of the Envision Team, is passionate about helping others and is committed to providing children with a better education. She aims to make an impact and gain a deeper understanding of the digital gap. Penny is excited about her upcoming journeys with Envision Education. Through the Nepal 2024 Project, Penny has played an incredible part in the Envision mission.

name: Ashlee Wang
bio: Ashlee is a member of the Envision team. Her passion for service and her curiosity about different cultures have been the driving force behind her journey of helping others. She has immersed herself in the communities she visits, and the most rewarding part of her endeavors is positively impacting other people’s lives. Her dedication and passion for service have helped shape her own values, and she has been an incredible part of the Envision journey.

name: Mr. Joe Fambro
bio: Joe Fambro is a native of Georgia, USA and the current Director of Innovation at Concordia International School Shanghai, where he channels his passion for technology, education, and innovation to drive learning in today’s digital age. He started his career in education in Raleigh, North Carolina, and his professional journey has led him through various roles in private and international schools in the USA, Korea, Malaysia, and now China. He is an Apple Distinguished Educator and enjoys working on his latte art skills, playing the piano, and exploring cultures.

name: Ms. Angela Steinbacher
bio: Angie Steinbacher teaches high school students courses to guide them in their faith journeys at Concordia. Angie is passionate about helping God's children in all walks of life, and she has aided our team in every aspect of our mission, especially through connecting with and serving the students with love. Though her journey with Concordia has ended, the impact she's had on our team and those we've served is lifelong.
